name: captures
source:
use merge from map
script variable state = 7
on go invoke
  put 3 into offset
  put given n: n + offset into f
  return invoke(f, 4)
end go

name: local-mutation
source:
use merge from map
script variable state = 7
on go invoke
  put [1] into original
  put given n
    put 2 after n
    return n
  end given into f
  return [invoke(f, original), original]
end go

  end try
 catch e
  return [the code of e, outer]
 end try
end go
